description: Route a qualified buyer enquiry about a specific property to Mirabello Consultancy (the broker of record and licensed advisor). Requires property_id (slug) + a valid email + explicit consent:true (GDPR). Side effect: delivers the enquiry to Mirabello and returns the next step. CBI/RBI property purchases must use a government-approved project and an authorised agent; Mirabello handles the purchase and the citizenship/residency application. Each call sends a separate enquiry, so do not repeat a call that succeeded.

budget.description: Budget the enquirer has stated, in their own words including the currency.

consent.description: must be true (GDPR consent to share details with Mirabello)

email.description: Contact email address for the enquiry. Only ever send an address the user has explicitly provided for this purpose.

message.description: The enquiry itself in the user’s own words. Do not add commitments or figures the user did not state.

name.description: Enquirer full name, only as the user has given it. Never invent or infer personal details.

nationality.description: Applicant's current citizenship, as a country name (for example India, Nigeria, Russia). Drives eligibility restrictions.

phone.description: Contact telephone number in international format, only if the user has provided it.

preferred_channel.description: How the enquirer prefers to be contacted: email, phone or WhatsApp.

residence_country.description: Country where the enquirer currently lives.

timeline.description: When the enquirer wants to proceed, in their own words (e.g. "within 3 months").

name: create_enquiry

outputSchema.description: Mirabello response envelope. Tool-specific fields vary; the provenance/disclaimer envelope is always present.

book_url.description: Link to request a consultation with a Mirabello specialist, for a personal case.

data_updated.description: Date the underlying dataset was last updated.

disclaimer.description: Information, not legal/tax/financial/immigration advice; figures indicative.

error.description: Present only when the request could not be fulfilled.

source.description: Attribution for the data, when it is not Mirabello Consultancy itself.

title: Create Real-Estate Enquiry
